function getHeptagonVertices(centerX, centerY, radius, rotationAngle) {
    const vertices = [];
    const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const angle = rotationAngle + i * angleStep;
        const x = centerX + radius * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = centerY + radius * Math.sin(angle);
        vertices.push({ x, y });
    }
    return vertices;
}

        if (cross < 0) {

}

                const normalX = dy;

                ball.vy -= 2 * dot * normal.y;

function isPointInsidePolygon(point, polygon) {
    let inside = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
        const a = polygon[i];
        const b = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
        const cross = (b.x - a.x) * (point.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (point.x - a.x);
        if (cross < 0) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    return inside;
}

function distanceFromPointToLineSegment(point, lineStart, lineEnd) {
    const x = point.x;
    const y = point.y;
    const x1 = lineStart.x;
    const y1 = lineStart.y;
    const x2 = lineEnd.x;
    const y2 = lineEnd.y;

    const denominator = (y2 - y1) * (x2 - x1);
    const numerator = (y2 - y1) * (x - x1) - (x2 - x1) * (y - y1);
    const t = numerator / denominator;

    const tClamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    const closestX = x1 + tClamped * (x2 - x1);
    const closestY = y1 + tClamped * (y2 - y1);

    const dx = x - closestX;
    const dy = y - closestY;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

function getHeptagonVertices(centerX, centerY, radius, rotationAngle) {
    const vertices = [];
    const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const angle = rotationAngle + i * angleStep;
        const x = centerX + radius * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = centerY + radius * Math.sin(angle);
        vertices.push({ x, y });
    }
    return vertices;
}
